products.body_html:
3-Piece Wheat Straw Baby Feeding Set with Cartoon Bear Design

This 3-piece baby feeding set combines eco-friendly materials with a charming cartoon bear design, creating an engaging mealtime experience for toddlers aged 1-2 years. Crafted from wheat straw and PP material, the set prioritizes safety and durability for daily feeding routines.

What's Included

The complete feeding set contains three essential pieces: a 20cm (7.87in) diameter bowl for serving cereals, pasta, and various meals; a 15.5cm x 3.3cm (6.1in x 1.3in) spoon designed for small hands to encourage self-feeding; and a 15.5cm x 2.5cm (6.1in x 0.98in) fork that helps develop fine motor skills. Available in three colors—pink, blue, and beige—to match your child's preferences and nursery decor.

Material & Safety Features

The wheat straw construction offers an eco-friendly alternative to traditional plastic feeding sets. Combined with high-quality PP material, this feeding set ensures durability through countless meals while remaining safe for toddler use. The lightweight design makes it easy for children to handle independently.

Practical Applications

Use this feeding set for everyday breakfast, lunch, and dinner meals. The appealing bear design helps introduce new foods to hesitant eaters, making food exploration less stressful. Perfect for playdates and family gatherings where your toddler can dine alongside others. The set also serves well during snack time for fruits, yogurt, and small bites. Makes a practical gift for baby showers or first birthday celebrations.

Age-Appropriate Design

Specifically sized for toddlers aged 1-2 years, each utensil promotes independence and proper grip development. The spoon and fork dimensions accommodate small hands learning to self-feed, while the bowl's 20cm diameter provides ample space for portion-appropriate meals. The cartoon bear motif captures attention and creates positive mealtime associations.

✅ EASY-TO-CLEAN & HYGIENIC: Silicone is a non-porous material resistant to stains and odors. These plates are easy to clean with soap and water and are often dishwasher and microwave-safe, making meal prep and cleanup a breeze.

HOW TO USE A BABY SILICONE DINNER PLATE

1. Place the Plate: Place the Baby Silicone Dinner Plate on a clean, flat surface.

2. Press to Secure: Press firmly on the plate to activate the suction base, ensuring a firm grip.

REASONS WHY A SILICONE FEEDING SPOON WILL CHANGE A BABY'S EXPERIENCE


✅ GENTLE ON SENSITIVE GUMS: A Baby Silicone Rice Paste Feeding Spoon is crafted from ultra-soft silicone that is gentle on a baby's delicate gums and new teeth. This feature makes it indispensable for preventing irritation and discomfort during feeding.

✅ PERFECT FOR FIRST FOODS: The shallow, flexible tip is designed to hold just the right amount of rice paste or pureed food, making it easy for a baby to accept and swallow. This design helps a parent confidently introduce a variety of first foods.




✅ EASY-TO-CLEAN & HYGIENIC: Silicone is a non-porous material resistant to bacteria and easy to clean. These spoons are designed with no seams or grooves where food can get stuck, making cleanup simple with soap and water or in the dishwasher.

HOW TO USE A BABY SILICONE FEEDING SPOON


1. Wash Before Use: Before the first use and after each meal, wash the Baby Silicone Rice Paste Feeding Spoon with warm, soapy water or place it in the dishwasher.

products.body_html:
Silicone Baby Bib – Waterproof Feeding Protection for Infants & Toddlers

The CradleLuxe Silicone Baby Bib provides reliable protection during mealtime with food-grade, BPA-free silicone construction. This waterproof feeding bib shields clothing from spills, dribbles, and stains while remaining gentle on sensitive skin.

The soft, flexible material moves naturally with your baby, ensuring comfort throughout feeding sessions. A deep catch pocket collects falling food and liquids, significantly reducing cleanup time. Adjustable straps accommodate infants and toddlers of various sizes, providing a secure fit that stays in place. The lightweight, durable design makes this bib suitable for home use, daycare environments, or travel.

Product Features

  • Safe Silicone Material: BPA-free, non-toxic, and baby-friendly.
  • Waterproof Design: Protects clothing from spills and dribbles.
  • Deep Food Pocket: Catches falling food to minimize mess.
  • Adjustable & Comfortable: Fits infants and toddlers securely.
  • Easy to Clean: Dishwasher safe or rinse with water for quick cleaning.

Why Choose Food-Grade Silicone?

Food-grade silicone offers distinct advantages for baby feeding products. The material resists staining and odor absorption, maintaining hygiene across repeated uses. Unlike fabric bibs that require washing and drying, silicone bibs clean instantly with a quick rinse or dishwasher cycle. The waterproof barrier prevents liquids from soaking through to clothing, while the flexible texture remains comfortable against delicate skin.

Deep Pocket Design

The integrated catch pocket extends outward to collect dropped food and spilled liquids before they reach your baby's lap or the floor. This design feature proves particularly valuable during self-feeding stages when infants and toddlers are developing motor skills. The pocket capacity handles substantial amounts of food, reducing the frequency of mid-meal cleanups.

Adjustable Fit for Growing Babies

Multiple adjustment settings on the neck strap allow the bib to grow with your child from early infancy through toddler years. The secure closure prevents removal by curious hands while maintaining comfort. The flexible silicone conforms to different body shapes without creating pressure points or restricting movement.

Maintenance and Care

Cleaning requires minimal effort—place the bib on the top rack of your dishwasher or rinse under running water. The non-porous silicone surface prevents bacterial growth and wipes clean without scrubbing. The material withstands repeated washing without degrading, cracking, or losing flexibility.

The CradleLuxe Silicone Baby Bib combines practical functionality with durable construction for reliable feeding protection.
